summary: This Form 6-K reports the results of Magnum Ice Cream Co N.V.'s Annual General Meeting held on May 7, 2026, where all proposals were passed, including adoption of financial statements, director remuneration, reappointment of directors, and board authorizations. The filing is a routine corporate governance update with no special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring. The document is a standard AGM outcome notice under Dutch law, filed as a foreign private issuer report. No deal terms, strategic changes, or unusual actions are present.
